description: Formula-aware visual resolver for Git merge conflicts in .xlsx/.xlsm planning tables: three-way sheet/row/cell diff, local UI, atomic write-back and commit.

environment.name: XLMERGE_PYTHON
environment.description: Python interpreter path; highest precedence, bypasses automatic discovery.

environment.name: XLMERGE_VENV
environment.description: Directory for the on-demand user-level virtualenv (default: ~/.xlmerge/venv).

environment.name: XLMERGE_EXCEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environment.description: Hard timeout for isolated Excel formula recalculation (default: 120 seconds per workbook).

agent.whenToUse: When a user asks to resolve Git merge conflicts in .xlsx/.xlsm planning or configuration tables (策划表/配置表冲突): run detect first; when reviewCount > 0 run launch and give the returned url to the user. Configured auto-theirs filters may resolve and commit matched generated workbooks without opening the UI. Do not inspect workbook cells or summarize diffs yourself; the resolver owns diff, choices, write-back and commit.

globalOptions.description: Git repository (default: current directory; searches upward for the Git root).
Optional directory for extracted Git stage workbooks and manifest (default: system temp). Used by prepare, resolve and launch.

commands.description: List unresolved .xlsx/.xlsm files in the repository.

output.description: Object with ok, repo, count, reviewCount, autoTheirs and conflicts (array of {path, stages}).

commands.description: Add a repository-scoped case-insensitive workbook path-suffix filter whose conflicts are adopted byte-for-byte from Git stage 3.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Relative .xlsx/.xlsm path suffix to adopt from Git stage 3.

output.description: Object with ok, repo, config, filter, added and the complete filters list. Writes <repo>/.xlmerge.json.

commands.description: Build a sheet-aware manifest; configured auto-theirs matches skip extraction and cell analysis.

output.description: Object with ok and manifest (absolute path to the manifest JSON).

exitCodes.1: error (no conflicts found, not a Git repository, git failure)

commands.description: Prepare conflicts and serve the local visual resolver in the foreground (blocking).

options.description: Print the URL instead of opening a browser.

output.description: Prints MERGE_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> for review conflicts; an all-filtered batch instead returns JSON after stage-3 write-back and commit.

exitCodes.0: success (resolution applied automatically or via UI; server shuts down after UI write-back)
exitCodes.1: error (prepare failure or server stopped before a resolution was applied)

commands.description: Prepare conflicts, start the visual resolver in the background and return its URL.

options.description: Start the server without opening a browser.

output.description: For review conflicts: object with ok, pid, url, manifest and log paths. For an all-filtered batch: url is null and autoResolved/steps report automatic stage-3 write-back and commit.

exitCodes.1: error (prepare failure or server did not report a URL within 15 seconds)

commands.description: Write back decisions from a decisions JSON without launching the UI.

options.description: Required. Manifest JSON produced by prepare.
Required. Decisions JSON with per-file per-sheet cell, row, column, rename and macro choices keyed by logical IDs.
Skip git add/commit after writing merged workbooks.
Override the auto-generated structured commit message.

output.description: Result object with success and summary of written files and commit.

exitCodes.1: error (invalid or incomplete decisions, git/OS failure)
